description: This file implements an SmsManager class for Android, providing functionality to send SMS messages and query SMS/MMS messages through the Android telephony content providers. It manages permissions, constructs queries, handles MMS-specific logic, and serializes data for communication with other components.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: A class to send SMS messages and perform SMS/MMS queries, with permission handling and data serialization.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Check if the app has permission to send SMS.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Check if the app has permission to read SMS.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Check if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determine if SMS can be sent (requires permission and telephony feature).

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determine if SMS search is possible (requires permission).

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Determine if SMS can be read (alias for canSearchSms).

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attach a PermissionRequester object for runtime permission requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Suspend function to send an SMS message given JSON parameters.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Suspend function to query SMS/MMS messages based on JSON parameters.
